facts.fact: MNTN states that its Performance TV platform optimizes across 50+ inputs, and that this produces thousands of campaign optimizations per day.
facts.value: 50+ inputs; thousands of optimizations per day
facts.quote: the campaign will automatically optimize across 50+ inputs to ensure your ads deliver the results you’re after

facts.fact: MNTN claims that other comparable software typically optimizes across 10+ dimensions to drive incremental reach versus linear TV buys.
facts.quote: other comparable software typically only optimizes across 10+ dimensions to drive incremental reach vs. linear TV buys

facts.fact: According to MNTN, advertisers using Performance TV averaged a 91% increase in ROAS compared with partially or manually optimized campaigns.
According to MNTN, advertisers using Performance TV averaged a 20% decrease in CPA compared with partially or manually optimized campaigns.
MNTN claims that manual CTV optimizations take three to five business days, whereas fully automated optimizations are done in an instant.
facts.quote: What can be done in an instant by true automated technology can take three to five business days when performed by a human.

facts.fact: MNTN describes its attribution model as using deduplicated visits, so it only credits actions driven by MNTN campaigns, unlike view-through attribution used by many CTV platforms.
facts.quote: Performance TV’s unique attribution model optimizes by using deduplicated visits, ensuring it only takes credit for consumer actions driven by MNTN campaigns.
